specs.name: think
specs.description:
Recursive thinking tool for sophisticated thought generation.

This tool implements a multi-cycle cognitive analysis approach that
progressively refines thoughts through iterative processing. Each cycle
builds upon insights from the previous cycle, creating a depth of analysis
that would be difficult to achieve in a single pass.

Returns:
    Dict containing status and response content in the format:
    {
        "status": "success|error",
        "content": [{"text": "Detailed thinking output across all cycles"}]
    }

    Success case: Returns concatenated results from all thinking cycles
    Error case: Returns information about what went wrong during processing

thought.description:
The detailed thought or idea to process through multiple thinking cycles.
This can be a question, statement, problem description, or creative prompt.

cycle_count.description:
Number of thinking cycles to perform (1-10). More cycles allow for
deeper analysis but require more time and resources. Typically 3-5 cycles
provide a good balance of depth and efficiency.

system_prompt.description:
Custom system prompt to use for the LLM thinking process. This should
specify the expertise domain and thinking approach for processing the thought.
Pass "" to use the built-in default: an evidence-based reasoning specialist
persona (skeptical, decision-oriented, appraises tool output as evidence).

thinking_system_prompt.description:
Optional custom thinking instructions that override the default
thinking methodology. This controls HOW the agent thinks about the problem, separate
from the system_prompt which controls the agent's persona/role. If omitted, the
built-in evidence-based parallel methodology is used: decompose the thought,
gather evidence with independent tool calls issued in parallel in a single turn,
appraise and rate each result, synthesize, and end with a structured
FINDINGS / CONFIDENCE / GAPS / NEXT ACTION handoff block. Prefer omitting this
unless the task needs a specialized methodology.

specs.name: create_fast_agent_response
specs.description:
Run a Perplexity Agent API research sub-agent using the 'fast' preset.

Starts a background streaming Agent API run with the fixed 'fast'
dynamic preset and returns the bounded terminal response to the caller.

Returns:
    Bounded serializable result with response_id, model, status,
    output_text, output items, usage, and error.

input.description: The task prompt: a string or a list of Agent API input items.

instructions.description: Optional system instructions for the run.

max_output_tokens.description:
Optional output token cap (required for
anthropic/* model overrides).

model.description: Optional model id override for the preset's default model.

models.description:
Optional ordered fallback list of 1-5 model ids; takes
precedence over model.

previous_response_id.description: Optional prior response id to continue from.

response_format.description: Optional structured output as a json_schema object.

tools.description:
Optional native Agent API tools (web_search, finance_search,
people_search, fetch_url, function, sandbox, mcp).

skills.description:
Optional Agent API skills (builtin office skills or inline
skill definitions).

specs.name: retrieve_agent_response
specs.description:
Retrieve a stored Agent API response by id.

Returns:
    The bounded response projection (response_id, model, status,
    output_text, output items, usage, error). Unknown, cross-account, or
    store:false responses fail non-retryably (the API returns 404).

response_id.description: The Agent API response id to retrieve.

specs.name: list_agent_response_files
specs.description:
List files produced by an Agent API response.

Returns:
    The supplied object/data shape with bounded file metadata entries.

response_id.description: The Agent API response id whose files to list.

specs.name: download_agent_response_file
specs.description:
Download one Agent API response file to the orchestrator file store.

Bytes are streamed to disk under ``config.AGENT_FILE_STORE_DIR`` and never
returned: the result carries only bounded metadata, the SHA-256, the Agent
API file path, and the browser-safe ``/api/orchestrator/file`` proxy URL.

Returns:
    Metadata: response_id, file_id, filename, content_type, bytes,
    sha256, path, and proxy url.

response_id.description: The Agent API response id owning the file.

specs.name: list_agent_models
specs.description:
List the live Perplexity Agent API model catalog (GET /v1/models).

This is the authoritative way to discover the CURRENT valid model ids.
Call it BEFORE passing a `model` override or constructing a `models`
fallback list for any of the create_*_agent_response tools, then use the
returned ids verbatim. Never guess, "correct", or hardcode model ids:
the catalog changes continuously and contains ids newer than any
training data. Not needed when a preset's default model is used.

Returns:
    The catalog in its OpenAPI list shape: {"object": "list", "data":
    [{"id", "object", "created", "owned_by"}, ...]}. Records without a
    usable id are dropped; ids are never altered.
